scope: Development diagnostics on the existing photographed bird and one-pixel crop perturbations. No additional reconstruction successes or new corpus pass rate are claimed. Experimental algorithms remain disabled.
productionChange: Retain every local-detail attempt and rejected geometry checkpoint; initialization, objective, refinement rates and acceptance rules are unchanged.

captureProvenance.description: Observation hooks around the existing local-detail stage; no algorithm changes. Hook cost means this is diagnostic, not a latency benchmark.

features.method: Both colours; four-connected interior source regions with a solid core. At least 60% of each region must remain its original colour. Regions touching the border or its one-pixel neighbourhood, and tiny or thin classification fragments, are excluded. All observed pixels still enter the image-error measurement. Small interior regions must also remain separate from the square boundary.
